summary: Iter85 ORRBBIT Business release-correction pass QA. Backend: 35/35 pass (5 new iter85 + 30 regression). New /app/backend/tests/test_iter85_business_release.py verifies: (1) GET /api/business/me returns 250 alphabetical countries (Australia/Japan/Zimbabwe/United Kingdom present, 'Other' appended at end); (2) POST /business/me with country 'Japan' stores country_code 'JP'; (3) GET /business/address-autocomplete → {enabled:false, suggestions:[]} (no GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY — known PARTIAL); (4) LOCK — analytics 403 while In Progress, remains 403 while Pending Review, event publish 403 while pending; after QA admin approve → analytics 200 (verified:true) and event creation 200; (5) Control lifecycle — start_review → 'In Review' with NO email_event recorded (tpl=None), revoke → 'Revoked', request_reverification → 'Reverification Required' with business_verification_more_info email_event recorded, reinstate → 'Verified'; each of the 4 actions produces admin_audit_logs entry (business_verification_start_review / _revoke / _request_reverification / _reinstate). Regression 30/30 (test_business_platform + test_iter81 + test_iter83 + test_iter84). Frontend mobile 390x844 (Playwright, JSON-stringified auth_token): PendingLock (testID biz-pending-lock) appears on business Home tab and Insights tab for Pending Review businesses — shows submitted details card + Continue Verification + Contact Support + Log out; NO KPI cards / NO Create Event visible while pending. After QA admin approve+reload: biz-verified-title one-time screen shown, tapping biz-verified-cta reveals FULL dashboard (Active Events / People Going / Event Views / Average Rating KPIs + Create Event CTA). Country search in /(auth)/business-setup step 1: initial run of test showed FAILURE — the 11-country fallback list was rendered because GET /api/business/me for a business with NO profile yet returned only {business:null, categories:[...]} (missing 'countries' + 'country_requirements'). Fixed backend business.py line 230-233 to always include countries+country_requirements in the null-biz branch → re-ran and country search 'jap' shows biz-country-Japan, 'zim' shows biz-country-Zimbabwe, selecting Japan renders biz-country-selected with 'Japan' + 'Change'. Web (1366x900) BizShell verified: /business/dashboard shows PendingLock (no KPIs), /business/subscription + /business/settings accessible while pending; after approve dashboard renders full Overview (KPIs + Create Event). Google Places autocomplete disabled (no key) is a known PARTIAL — not failed. Cleaned all @orrbbitqa.example.com QA data.
